supersedes.note: V1 file, checksum, code (deterministic.py) and results stay unchanged and immutable; V2 is a separate generator

declaration.purpose: Repair the two class-E defects V1 measured, exactly as the operator decided before V2 (A: R3.1 business evidence with a deterministic Item 1 fallback and fail-neutral NOT_READY; B: deterministic guidance transcription; C: no large re-rating threshold). Everything else is V1 verbatim.

operator_decisions_frozen_before_v2.A_R3_1: explicit BUSINESS evidence, else deterministic 10-K Item 1 fallback, else BUSINESS_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY; extraction failure is never 'business unsupported' and never a D6 REJECT
operator_decisions_frozen_before_v2.B_guidance: IMPLEMENT deterministic transcription of metric / range / period / unit from the disclosure; no AI

authority_order: historical model output (never an answer key)
declaration.revision_rule: a rule change after the replay is a new contract version (V3), never an edit of V2

unchanged_from_v1.d6_binding_projection: V1 section d6_binding_projection, verbatim (D6 code unchanged)
unchanged_from_v1.d3_rule_r3_10: V1 R3.10 verbatim; with R3.1 V2 a final output always carries a business citation, so 'business_model' is never added
unchanged_from_v1.d4_inputs_and_c_rules: V1 d4.inputs_code_owned, confidence (C4/C5), priced_in UNKNOWN, conflicts [], d6_approve_precondition
unchanged_from_v1.verdict_rule: class E on a D6-binding path is NEEDS REVISION unless this contract lists it as an operator-decided deferral

d3.construction: the V1 generator's record (final_output, or attempted_output when V1 refused) with R3.1 replaced by R3.1_V2, unknown_fields / sources / research_completeness recomputed by the V1 rules, then validated again by the same h_research_interpretation_v2 schema and cross-check

source_priority: P1 EXPLICIT_BUSINESS_CHUNK: the first chunk with section BUSINESS of the package's LATEST_10K source (V1's citation, unchanged)
P2 ITEM1_FALLBACK: deterministic Item 1 extraction from the same LATEST_10K source's text in the package
P3 OTHER_FROZEN_EQUIVALENT: none exists in any frozen H-V2 contract (audited 2026-10-14); never used
never_business_evidence: any filing outside the D2.1 package
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.fallback_text: the LATEST_10K source's package chunks joined with '\n' in chunk_index order (D2.1 chunks the whole extracted document; offsets refer to this text)
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.line_normalisation: NBSP and runs of whitespace -> one space, stripped; a line containing '|' is a table cell (tables of contents) and is never a heading
heading_grammar: two lines: ^item\s*1\s*[.:\-\u2013\u2014]?$ followed by the next non-empty line ^(?:description\s+of\s+(?:the\s+)?)?business(?:\s+and\s+properties)?\s*\.?$
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.terminator: the first later non-table line matching ^item\s*(?:1a|1b|1c|2)\b (Item 1A Risk Factors ends Item 1; 1B/1C/2 only when 1A is absent)
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.qualifying_heading: the first heading, in document order, that has a terminator AND at least one non-heading, non-table line containing a letter between them; a heading without a terminator is malformed
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.citation: the chunk containing the first body line after the heading (a chunk of the package, so the D3 schema's evidence-id check still applies)
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.amendment_policy: the LATEST_10K the frozen D2 selection chose (10-K or 10-K/A, PIT) is the only source; a 10-K/A without Item 1 (Part III amendments) gives BUSINESS_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY with reason AMENDMENT_WITHOUT_ITEM_1; no other filing is fetched or substituted
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.fail_neutral: BUSINESS_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY never writes an empty revenue_drivers: the D3 record is refused (no final_output, refusal R3.1_BUSINESS_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY), which D6 reads as D3_REFUSED_NO_FINAL_OUTPUT -> NOT_DECISION_ELIGIBLE: the existing decision stands, a new candidate is not admitted. thesis_unsupported can no longer fire through the business leg.
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.claim_text_p2: Issuer business description disclosed in the latest 10-K (Item 1, deterministic fallback extraction).
R3.1_V2_business_evidence.basis: operator decision A; D0 §N3 'thesis unsupported by the evidence bundle' is about evidence, not about a D2.1 section label

guidance_parser.role: transcription only: metric label, period, currency, unit, low, high, single value, source text, source_id, evidence_id, accession, form, filing date. No economic reading.
guidance_parser.sources: the D2.1 package chunks D4 already reads (LATEST_10K, RECENT_10Q, material 8-K bodies and their EX-99 exhibits incl. 2.02 earnings releases, IR presentations); PIT-eligible only; no new source class
guidance_parser.location: sentences that match the frozen GUIDANCE_TERMS (guidance_arithmetic.py, unchanged)
guidance_parser.tables: lines containing '|' are not transcribed (recorded as table_lines_with_guidance_terms); a table needs a column reading this contract does not freeze
guidance_parser.metric_vocabulary: no frozen guidance-metric vocabulary exists in the repository (audited: D4 schema metric is free text; stored Opus outputs use 40+ free labels). The metric is the label exactly as the source writes it; comparison key = that label lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed, with only determiners/possessives (its, our, the, their), period expressions and a trailing 'guidance'/'outlook' removed. No synonym, no mapping, no ontology.

templates.T1_verb_object: <guidance verb> [its|our|the] <label> [guidance|outlook] (to be|of|at|in the range of|within a range of|to range from|to|from <prev> to|between) <range>
templates.T2_subject_passive: <label> [guidance] (is|are) [now] (expected|anticipated|projected|forecast|forecasted|estimated) to [be|range from|total|grow by|increase by|decrease by|decline by] [approximately|about|in the range of|between] <range>
templates.T3_guidance_noun: (guidance|outlook) for <label> (of|to be|is|at|to) <range>  |  <label> (guidance|outlook) (of|is|at|range of|to a range of|to) <range>
templates.previous_in_sentence: after the current range: [, ] [up|down] (from|compared to|compared with|versus|vs.) [the|its|our] (prior|previous|earlier) (guidance|outlook|range|expectation)[s] [range] [of] <range>; or the T1 'from <prev> to <cur>' form

range_grammar.number: [(] [$|€|£] digits with optional thousands commas and decimals [)]; parentheses = negative as accounting text writes it
range_grammar.scale: thousand|million|billion|mn|bn|K|M|B directly after a number; a scale stated only on the second number of a range applies to the first only when the first has none
range_grammar.percent: % | percent | per cent -> PERCENT; basis points | bps -> BPS (kept as its own unit family; normalised value = raw / 100 percentage points)
range_grammar.range: between A and B | A to B | A - B (hyphen, en dash, em dash) | from A to B
range_grammar.single_value: approximately|about|around|roughly A, or 'of' / 'to be' / 'at' A with no second number: low = high = A, single_value = true
range_grammar.incomplete_bound: at least|up to|more than|less than|in excess of|exceeding|below|above A -> INCOMPLETE_BOUND (recorded, never compared)
range_grammar.malformed: high < low as written -> MALFORMED_RANGE (recorded, never reordered)

guidance_parser.unit: currency symbol $ -> USD; USD with a label containing EPS / per share / earnings per -> USD_PER_SHARE; PERCENT; BPS; no currency and no percent -> OTHER with the next word as raw_unit (e.g. tonnes); comparable only within the same (unit, raw_unit, currency) family
guidance_parser.normalisation: normalised = raw x scale (thousand 1e3, million/mn/M 1e6, billion/bn/B 1e9); bps /100; raw text, raw numbers, scale word and normalised values are all kept; raw values are never changed

period.FY: (full year|full-year|fiscal|fiscal year|FY) [']YYYY or YYYY (full year|fiscal year) -> FY<YYYY>; YY -> 20YY
period.Q: (first|second|third|fourth) quarter [of] [fiscal [year]] YYYY | Q[1-4] [FY|fiscal] [']YYYY|YY | YYYY (first..fourth) quarter -> Q<n>-<YYYY>
period.bare_year: YYYY with no FY/Q marker -> YEAR<YYYY> (compatible only with YEAR<YYYY>)
period.binding: a period inside the label first; else the single distinct period in the sentence; otherwise GUIDANCE_PERIOD_UNKNOWN (recorded, never compared). Relative periods (next quarter, full year without a year) are GUIDANCE_PERIOD_UNKNOWN.

current_vs_previous.current: the transcriptions of the latest published_at in the group
current_vs_previous.previous: the in-sentence previous range of a current transcription when stated; otherwise the transcriptions of the latest earlier published_at in the group
current_vs_previous.comparable: both sides present, same group, complete bounds (no INCOMPLETE_BOUND, no MALFORMED_RANGE)
current_vs_previous.one_sided: UNKNOWN (current only or previous only); INITIATED and WITHDRAWN are statements about an absence and are never produced (guidance_arithmetic MOVEMENT_TO_STATE note)
current_vs_previous.conflict: two different values on the same side at the same published_at (or two different in-sentence previous ranges) -> GUIDANCE_CONFLICT -> UNKNOWN
current_vs_previous.amendment: no amendment / supersede contract exists for guidance in the repository; a later-published source (an 8-K/A included) is simply the later side by publication time; no tie-break is invented

guidance_parser.direction: guidance_arithmetic.classify_range_movement on the normalised bounds, mapped by MOVEMENT_TO_STATE (RAISED, LOWERED, MAINTAINED, MIXED_BOUNDS -> MIXED); NOT_COMPARABLE -> UNKNOWN
guidance_parser.result_vs_guidance: not produced (needs a reported-actual transcription that operator decision B does not cover)

d4.code_owned_non_price_items: count of guidance assessments in {RAISED, LOWERED, MAINTAINED, MIXED} = validate._non_price_expectation_items' guidance rule; C1 is now evaluable by code

G1_V2_POSITIVE.basis: D0 §L POSITIVE = (evidenced improvement or real future-business evidence) AND 'at least low-to-medium confidence that the market has not fully priced it'. C1 is now satisfiable, but the second conjunct is the priced-in inference and the confidence level, which D4 §N/§Q assign to AI with no frozen code reading; a guidance direction is the company's expectation, not evidence that the market is behind (D4 §L asymmetry). Reading 'guidance raised' as 'not priced' would be a new economic hypothesis.

G1_V2_WIDE_POSITIVE.basis: C2 needs a future-business item above STORY (R3.4: none) plus the POSITIVE conjuncts; the D0 valuation conjunct stays deferred as V1/D4 recorded it; D5 is not used to extend it

G2_V2_NEGATIVE.large_rerating: LARGE_RERATING_NEGATIVE = DEFERRED (operator decision C, no threshold)
G2_V2_NEGATIVE.not_yet_reflected: D0 §L 'deterioration ... not yet reflected in price/guidance' has no frozen code reading; a LOWERED guidance is itself the deterioration being reflected in guidance

G3_V2_NEUTRAL.basis: 'reasonable reflection' has no frozen test; D6-equivalent to UNKNOWN

G4_V2_UNKNOWN.rule: the state in every case; reason codes state which conjunct is missing; C6 when the bundle has no price reaction and no code-owned non-price item

d4.record: final_output.code_owned_expectation_evidence.guidance = every transcription, assessment, conflict and limitation of the parser

expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.REJECT: no longer reachable through a missing BUSINESS label; still reachable through D5 fully priced, R3.2 empty, or no catalyst within the horizon (V1, unchanged)
expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.NOT_DECISION_ELIGIBLE: R3.1_V2 NOT_READY (e.g. a Part III 10-K/A), R3.5 underivable, R3.12 validation, or D5 abstention
expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.APPROVE: NOT reachable from the deterministic pipeline. Independent blockers on D0 §N1, none of them in operator decisions A-C: (1) G1_V2 priced-in conjunct and confidence (E_CORE), (2) catalyst materiality and timing confidence, R3.5 (E_APPROVE_PATH), with future-business R3.4 as the only alternative (E_APPROVE_PATH), (3) invalidation condition, R3.7 (E_APPROVE_PATH). The D6 APPROVE path itself is exercised with synthetic D3/D4 records that carry those fields, through the unchanged D6 and paper engine.

fixtures.clear_positive: expected UNKNOWN (no frozen POSITIVE reading; constructing a POSITIVE would need a new condition)
fixtures.negative: no fixture: the only deterministic candidate path (large re-rating) is DEFERRED

expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.historical_replay: DORM: V1 REJECT (thesis_unsupported via R3.1) -> V2 business evidence from the Item 1 fallback, thesis_unsupported no longer fires; D6 decision otherwise by the unchanged clauses
